follow_up_questions.question: Have the episodes become more frequent or longer, come on with less exertion, or happened at rest, and has any lasted more than 15 to 20 minutes?
follow_up_questions.why: A crescendo or rest pattern would mean unstable angina needing same-day evaluation rather than a cardiology visit next week.

follow_up_questions.question: What other medicines do you take, including over-the-counter pain relievers like ibuprofen, supplements, or any erectile-dysfunction-type drugs (sildenafil, tadalafil)?
follow_up_questions.why: No full medication list was taken before starting aspirin, nitroglycerin and hydrochlorothiazide, and NSAIDs or PDE5 inhibitors interact with them.

follow_up_questions.question: Do you smoke, and when was your cholesterol last checked?
follow_up_questions.why: Smoking and lipids are key cardiac risk factors that were not covered and affect the angina workup and statin decision.
